title: 第3章 六指师父吃传承的种子第4章 铁山靠活着走出去
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
令牌在跳。
咚。
咚。
咚。
和苏意的心跳同一个节奏。
苏意攥着黑铁令牌，盯着那具六指骸骨。
骸骨的左手六根手指，指甲全磨秃了，指骨上有变形的痕迹——不是被打断的，是被什么东西反复烫、反复磨，骨头自己长歪了。
苏意脑子里闪过一个画面。
前世电线厂那个被冲床压断两根手指的线长，姓刘，人人都叫他刘断指。
他走的那天把手套摘下来放在工作台上，说：“这手艺传不下去，没人愿意学。”
然后走得很慢，背影弓着，像背上压着什么东西。
画面碎掉。
骸骨的眉心，那一点灵光忽然炸开。
不是光。
是刺。
一道无形的力量从灵光中射出，直刺苏意眉心。
不是杀意——是试探。
像有人拿针尖悬在你眼皮上半寸，不扎，就让你感受那个尖。
苏意退了半步。
身体自己退的。

不是武功反应，是前世流水线质检练出来的本能——盯着传送带八个小时，错一个都不行。
那双眼练了三年，连机器故障前一瞬间的异常抖动都能捕捉到。
刚才骸骨眉心灵光渗出时，光纹的扩散速度不对，和正常灵光衰减的节奏差了半拍。
他的身体认出这个异常，比他脑子快。
“咦？”
灵光里传出一声轻咦。
然后光开始凝聚。
从针尖大的一点，拉长、拉宽，化成一道人形。
残魂。
干瘦老头，穿着和苏意一模一样的矿奴服。
左手六根手指，右手攥着一个虚影——那是他临死前手里握着的东西，黑铁令牌的虚影。
眼窝深得像两口枯井，颧骨高耸，下巴尖削。
他一出现就盯着苏意上下打量。
“五息。”
他开口了，声音像砂纸刮铁锈，“五息之内能反应过来躲老夫的魂刺——是个好苗子。”
苏意没说话。
“魂刺无形无质，修为低于凝气五层的人根本感知不到。”
残魂飘近一步，那双枯井似的眼窝盯着苏意的眼睛，“你身上没有半点灵力波动，一个连气感都没开的矿奴——怎么做到的？”
苏意还是没说话。
他低头看了看自己的手。
content_en:
The token is jumping.
Boom.
Boom.
Boom.
The same rhythm as Su Yi's heartbeat.
Su Yi clutched the black iron token and stared at the six-fingered skeleton.
The nails on the six fingers of the left hand of the skeleton were all worn out, and there were signs of deformation on the phalanges - they were not broken, but were repeatedly burned and rubbed by something, and the bones grew crooked on their own.
A picture flashed in Su Yi's mind.
The line leader who had two fingers crushed by a punch in his previous life at the electric wire factory was named Liu, and everyone called him Liu Broken Finger.
On the day he left, he took off his gloves and put them on the workbench, saying, "This skill cannot be passed on, no one wants to learn it."
Then he walked very slowly, his back arched, as if something was pressing on his back.
The screen is broken.
Between the skeleton's brows, that little spiritual light suddenly exploded.
Not light.
It's a thorn.
An invisible force shot out from the spiritual light and pierced Su Yi's eyebrows.
It wasn't murderous intent - it was temptation.
It's like someone holding the tip of a needle half an inch above your eyelids, without pricking it, just letting you feel the tip.
Su Yi took half a step back.
The body retreats on its own.
It's not a martial arts reaction, it's an instinct developed from the quality inspection of the assembly line in the previous life - staring at the conveyor belt for eight hours, not making a single mistake.
Those eyes have been trained for three years, and they can even capture the abnormal shaking of the machine at the moment before it breaks down.
When the spiritual light from the skeleton eyebrows seeped out just now, the diffusion speed of the light pattern was wrong, half a beat behind the normal rhythm of the spiritual light decay.
His body recognized the anomaly faster than his mind.
"Huh?"
A soft cry came from the spiritual light.
Then the light begins to condense.
From the larger point of the needle, it is lengthened and widened, forming a human shape.
Remnant soul.
A skinny old man, wearing the same mining slave uniform as Su Yi.
There were six fingers on his left hand, and his right hand held a phantom - that was the thing he held in his hand before he died, the phantom of the black iron token.
The eye sockets are as deep as two dry wells, the cheekbones are high, and the chin is sharp.
As soon as he appeared, he stared at Su Yi and looked him up and down.
"Five breaths."
He spoke, his voice sounding like sandpaper scraping rust, "You can react to dodge my soul thorn within five breaths - that's a good idea."
Su Yi said nothing.
"The soul thorn is invisible and has no quality, and people with a cultivation level lower than the fifth level of Qi Condensation cannot feel it at all."
The remnant soul took a step closer, staring at Su Yi's eyes with those dry well-like eye sockets, "You don't have any spiritual power fluctuations in your body. How can you do it as a mine slave who doesn't even have a sense of energy?"
Su Yi still didn't speak.
He looked down at his hands.
